text:
matt.j: Quick check — spotted ~200MB of staging logs in S3 that include customer_id and hashed_email fields. Can I just run the delete or do we need an approval/erase ticket?
sara.v: staging or prod bucket?
matt.j: staging-only: s3://redwood-staging/logs/2026/03/15/*
retention-bot: FYI: Staging buckets have auto-purge 30d, but manual erases require confirmation when customer identifiers are present. Policy: <https://redwood.internal/docs/data-retention> :information_source:
kai: If hashed_email is just a one-way hash with per-environment salt, probably ok to delete without legal, but confirm salt not shared with prod.
matt.j: salt is the env var SALT_LOCAL — only on dev/staging runners, not prod. That said, hashes were generated by a debug job that might have used a shared fixture.
sara.v: OK, sounds borderline. @devops can you hold off on any manual rm for now? we should create an erase ticket so legal/compliance can sign off.
devops: ack, holding. If you paste the exact path + reason we can queue it in the erase workflow. Emergency removes require 2 infra approvals.
matt.j: copying path here and reason: 
```
# path
s3://redwood-staging/logs/2026/03/15/debug-job-xyz/*.log
# reason
contain customer_id and hashed_email from intermittent debug run
```
sara.v: filing INF ticket now and adding legal/compliance reviewers. will tag here when created. :+1:
matt.j: thanks. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8421 (erase request created, assigned to legal)
retention-bot: Ticket INF-8421 created; retention flag set to "pending-erase" and delete blocked until approval. See <https://redwood.internal/erase-workflow/INF-8421>
kai: once legal confirms, devops can run a scoped `aws s3 rm` command with the ticket id in the audit log. Example to use after approval: 
```
aws s3 rm s3://redwood-staging/logs/2026/03/15/debug-job-xyz/ --recursive --profile devops --tagging "erase_ticket=INF-8421"
```
sara.v: note to self: follow up with SRE to confirm snapshots/backups don't contain same files.
matt.j: good catch — I'll open a follow-up if legal approves.
devops: leaving a hold; will wait for approval to run clear.
retention-bot: Reminder scheduled in 48h to check INF-8421 status.
